name: WordCraft v0.8.0
body:
## What's Changed
* CI: main passes again (Word 2003 check reads through io; first keystroke after a chrome click isn't dropped) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1578
* Interface-translation audit green and back in CI (#1128) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1143
* Double-click the margin to create and edit a header or footer (#960) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1144
* Alt+numpad character codes (#961) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1146
* Review › Language reaches every proofing language (#860) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1151
* Dark theme: the ruler text area is lighter than its margins by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1154
* Print: the preview fills the pane, with a zoom bar and scrolling both ways by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1157
* Zotero: text typed just after a citation goes outside its field by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1162
* Layout: a list label moves with its text when the paragraph is aligned (#1159) by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1163
* CI: translate Croatian in every interface catalog by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1719
* Full screen on F11 and View › Window › Full Screen (#980) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1153
* Layout: a paragraph ending with a page break leaves its space after on the old page by @naxvog in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1168
* Picture transparency/corrections/color are absolute from the original + transparency slider by @DevCoderMax in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1175
* Fonts embedded in a .docx lay out and export its text by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1176
* Layout: table rows share their cell margins and split across pages like Word by @naxvog in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1177
* Stop Space and Enter from resetting the X11 input context by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1179
* Equations: bound parser tree depth, escape \text in LaTeX, merge runs everywhere (#1456) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1457
* i18n: add Vietnamese (vi) interface translation by @Nghiathan13 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1458
* Tables: thick cell borders meet in closed corners by @dfgodvan in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1461
* Close prompt: a failed Save says why and keeps the document open (#1445) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1465
* Metafile: WMF object table without scanning, in-place shape ops, cropped DIB decode (#1463) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1466
* i18n(hu): align two new rows with the catalog terms by @Skaywalker in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1469
* References: TOC entries carry their headings' list numbers by @dfgodvan in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1470
* PDF: draw horizontal and vertical lines inside groups by @cyril265 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1474
* Layout: PAGE fields on the later pages of a paragraph show their own page (#1352) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1481
* fix(proof): classify each whitespace token once when checking spelling (#1335) by @saadkhantareen in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1490
* Shapes: rounded rectangles keep their own corner radius by @cyril265 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1476
* Fields: PAGEREF in headers and footers shows its bookmark's page by @cyril265 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1477
* Ctrl+A stays on this page, and in a table grows cell, then row, then table, then the document (#1424) by @ImpotStite in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1478
* Word 365 cover pages: page-relative positions and freeforms drawn back to their start (#743) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1487
* Fix Replace All bypassing content-control locks by @MMexicann in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1488
* RTF import: keep section breaks and their page settings (#1378) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1495
* Save As: fill the file type list (#1399) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1497
* HTML import: bold header cells, cell alignment and the region paper (#1381) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1494
* Custom page sizes: Size › More Paper Sizes and Page Setup width/height (#1433) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1496
* Dark page: highlights are dimmed so the text on them stays readable (#1252) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1498
* Fix mini toolbar positioning while scrolling by @shlok2721-web in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1501
* Canvas: draw colour emoji on screen as the PDF does (#1269) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1504
* .doc import: cell shading, column count and merged cells (#1380) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1507
* Layout: long tables keep one layout per cell and relayout without re-measuring by @dfgodvan in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1492
* Layout: a paragraph continued into the next column wraps around a shape there (#1374) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1505
* ODT import: keep each section’s page properties (#1379) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1506
* PDF export: Hebrew and Arabic text extracts in reading order (#1383) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1508
* Web: image paste goes to the active edit target (#1349) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1513
* Track Changes and content controls: table delete, Change Case and Unlink Fields respect them (#1329) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1514
* PDF export: All Caps text extracts correctly (#1473) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1509
* Web: New/Open waits for Save before discarding the document (#1315) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1510
* Document Inspector: find hidden text outside the body and from styles (#1344) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1515
* RTF: read and write tracked changes (insertions, deletions, authors, times) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1516
* Canvas: alignment guides while dragging pictures and shapes by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1519
* Draw: Ink to Shape recognises arrows by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1520
* fix(math): preserve equation text color on save/load (#1467) by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1525
* fix(proof): British spellings such as honour and prioritise are not flagged (#40) by @HyakoV3 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1536
* ODT: read and write tracked changes (text:tracked-changes) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1517
* fix(pdf): inline pictures keep their alt text in tagged PDF (#1502) by @HyakoV3 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1526
* proof: Turkish spelling, suggestions, grammar and hyphenation by @yeniufuklar-com in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1527
* ODT and .doc import: pictures are read once, within their byte budget (#1334) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1554
* macOS: the title bar fits around the traffic lights as macOS draws them by @kkilchrist in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1559
* CI: Turkish review-command test skips without a Turkish dictionary by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1752
* --help and -h print the usage for the app and every CLI command (#968) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/977
* fix(cli): reject invalid page and scale arguments by @NavidZamanKhan in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/982
* Native print test: fixed PDF creation date, no flaky byte comparison (#987) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/990
* Tables: AutoFit in a nested table, whole cells shaded for a selection through a table, Shift+Right at a cell's end by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1004
* Reset table tools on table deletion and preserve Draw Table outside tables by @y2w8 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1006
* fix(markdown): preserve table cells containing code spans and pipes by @NavidZamanKhan in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1009
* Focus hides the ribbon, status bar and panes; Escape brings them back by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1017
* Ribbon tabs that don't fit move to a » menu instead of under Comments by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/958
* i18n(cs): wording fixes after #387 by @Losminek in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/973
* #916: Cross-reference opens a dialog by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1003
* feat(engine): rename documents from the title bar and open account settings from the badge by @neupaneprashant in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1016
* Track Changes: rejecting a whole inserted paragraph keeps the next paragraph's style and numbering by @przemek-arch in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1020
* Caret: Down and Up from a line start beside a table go into it, not past it by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1021
* macOS: Control-click opens the context menu, with its spelling suggestions by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1025
* DOCX: a hyperlink with an empty target is no link (#1005) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1030
* i18n(cs): complete the Czech catalog (built-in styles, equation gallery) by @Losminek in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/978
* One Page and the zoom are saved with the document and restored when it is reopened by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1023
* DOCX: keep Office 2016 charts (cx:chart) and their data when saving by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1029
* Table eraser: borders beside vertically merged cells merge as in Word (#1039) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1044
* Layout: keep with next moves the heading when the next paragraph moves for widow control (#966) by @albayazid in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1049
* Ribbon menu buttons carry their name for accessibility by @tarpescu in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1050
* Page background: picture and texture fills are drawn and kept on save (#999) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1036
* Ribbon: holding a press no longer scrolls the document (#1019) by @lasse-tech in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1041
* Track Changes: deletions inside a field result are tracked, accepted and saved (#1037) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1043
* feat(ui): implement Ctrl+drag to copy objects on canvas by @guruswarupa in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1046
* fonts: Add platform-specific Hebrew font support by @H0ruu1 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1052
* DOCX: merge settings.xml into the original instead of regenerating it (#1034) by @przemek-arch in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1059
* CI: Hebrew font substitution test expects David only on Windows by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1790
* Comments: a click inside a selected balloon moves the caret in its text (#1013) by @lasse-tech in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1051
* UI: mini toolbar steps aside for the ribbon by @Toddpe in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1069
* Docs: encrypted DOCX row, duplicate document-grid rows, dated issue count by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1072
* Contributors: add Sazid Al Bayazid (albayazid) to people.toml by @albayazid in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1074
* UI: combo boxes join their dropdown arrow (field rounded left, arrow right) by @Toddpe in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1083
* Proofing: a Dictionaries folder setting, and the dictionary each language found (#1063) by @witkowski01 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1084
* CI: park the mini-toolbar scroll test that #1501 and #1069 disagree on by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1834
* DOCX: carry unmodelled parts; keep comment ids, style defaults, latent styles, list ids and app props (#1034) by @przemek-arch in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1060
* Comments: an option to show only the selected text's comment (#1055) by @lasse-tech in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1066
* Docs: gaps.md re-audited against main by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1071
* README: install on Gentoo from the ::snakebyte overlay by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/16
* macOS packaging: strip extended attributes before signing and verify the DMG's app strictly (#525) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/527
* fix(layout): match Word's contextual paragraph spacing by @OPUZZLES in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/568
* STYLEREF fields show each page's result in headers and footers (#775) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/882
* Mail merge: .xls recipients, legacy encodings, Filter and Sort (#778) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/885
* .doc: open password-protected Word 97–2003 files (RC4, RC4 CryptoAPI, XOR) (#1079) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1087
* fix(layout): prevent list labels from inflating line height by @OPUZZLES in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/601
* Russian proofing: spelling, suggestions, grammar and word division by @xmaks82 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/894
* File: recover unsaved work after a crash (#518) by @OPUZZLES in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/586
* fix(layout): preserve legacy table paragraph spacing by @OPUZZLES in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/577
* STYLEREF review follow-ups: headers stay cached, switch labels in our own words (#1286) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1294
* CI: recovery pruning test retries a scan that a lock race skipped by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1849
* Word forms keep their legacy form fields and rows' skipped grid columns when saved by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1184
* Keytips: Alt, J, T and Alt, J, L open the table tabs like Word by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1185
* Modify Style picks its font from the font box the ribbon uses by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1187
* UI: fix Select icon polygon rendering by @marc-antoine-girard in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1193
* Desktop: a maximized window no longer flashes on and off at start-up on Windows (#23) by @tlomts-dev in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1194
* Tables: Select All then Delete removes a table the document starts with; right-click Delete offers Delete Table again by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1202
* Right-click on a table of contents entry offers Update Field by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1203
* Navigation pane headings align left, indented under their parent by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1204
* Layout menus mark the current margins, orientation, size and columns by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1214
* Ctrl+Q resets the paragraph without also closing the window by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1220
* Ctrl+wheel zoom keeps the place under the pointer instead of scrolling the page away by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1226
* Harden against hostile-document DoS and non-web link export by @JeremyYao in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1235
* i18n(it): translate the 24 strings other catalogs added since #598 by @fabiodalez-dev in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1244
* Fonts: the interface CJK fallback skips faces without outlines by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1250
* fix: remove dead-code unwrap_or magic string in percent_decode by @ahutsunshin in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1257
* Cut copies to the system clipboard from every control by @tarpescu in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1256
* fix: remove unreachable empty-string branch in open_bytes_with match by @ahutsunshin in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1258
* Accessibility: Windows Magnifier follows the caret onto a new line (#1119) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1247
* Desktop: a window too big for its screen shrinks to fit when it opens (#1215) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1253
* feat: add SVG and ICO MIME types to mime_of helper by @ahutsunshin in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1262
* Table Layout: the Cell Size boxes apply to the whole selection (#1242) by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1276
* Insert › Bookmark: Delete and Go To, laid out as Word's (#1236) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1277
* Improve Polish spelling suggestions for final consonant devoicing by @neronek22 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1298
* fix(ui): prevent options pane labels from overflowing (#1266) by @Zaxaerith in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1301
* CI: Select All + Delete test presses Select All until the document is selected by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1865
* Layout: inside/outside floats swap sides on even pages; Page Setup shows mirror margins (#1181) by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1239
* refactor: deduplicate ZIP and OLE magic number constants in io.rs by @ahutsunshin in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1260
* UI: view-mode tooltips, SmartArt labels and TOC style names follow the interface language by @andrejskvorc in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1272
* Restrict Editing: filling in forms opens fillable content controls (#1077) by @edurbs in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1309
* fix(ui): drag a Behind Text picture or shape over the text it overlaps by @mute-09 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1313
* Word's text watermark in DOCX: drawn on screen and in the PDF, and kept on save (#1290) by @mmazzieri in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1328
* Insert Hyperlink: Link to › Place in This Document (#1234) by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1370
* An empty .docx opens as a blank document that saves back to it (#1384) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1387
* Scripts can't close a document with unsaved changes without force (#1268) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1391
* Paragraph dialog: leave mixed formatting alone, apply as one undo step (#1346) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1397
* fix(geom): measurement parser rejects overflow to infinity during unit conversion (#1359) by @krinry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1398
* xtask assets: fail when git ls-files fails, read raw NUL-separated paths (#1364) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1401
* Mouse wheel keeps scrolling while a text selection is being dragged (#1388) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1402
* Save preferences through a temporary file and log write failures (#1361) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1404
* RTF import decodes Unicode escapes in font names (#1360) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1406
* MCP type_text reports a refused paragraph break instead of typing the next line (#1356) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1407
* Print to PDF and PNG export replace the file only after it is fully written (#1355) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1408
* Restart Numbering keeps the list's own level definitions (#1351) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1409
* Document::delete_range checks both ends before editing, so an error leaves the document unchanged (#1350) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1410
* Styles gallery shows Word's quick styles for DOCX files that mark none, e.g. from LibreOffice (#1238) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1394
* Outline Promote, Demote, Move Up and Move Down add one undo step instead of two (#1363) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1403
* DOCX: cap the depth of header/footer parts that reference further headers/footers (#1322) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1415
* Convert Text to Table refuses to drop fields or a table in the selection (#1318) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1416
* Layout: formats past 65,536 in one paragraph keep their own style (#1340) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1421
* #967: keep with next, keep lines together, page break before and widow control list their {"value"?: bool} by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1427
* wordcraft --control checks its port (#1426) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1436
* #1376: a word too wide for the strip beside a floating picture moves on whole by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1439
* DOCX: draw VML preset shapes such as Word's right arrow (#1377) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1442
* Picture Format › Crop: crop handles on the canvas by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1447
* Canvas: a redrawn page goes to egui as rendered, without a round trip through straight alpha by @spiritbearlabs in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1450
* Markdown import: brackets no longer turn later links in the paragraph into plain text (#1452) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1453
* JSON open repairs hostile run lengths (#1337) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1412
* Free part, list and comment ids after a file's largest ones (#1338) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1428
* Page Setup: Justified vertical alignment (#1320) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1435
* insert.picture and insert.icon leave the caret after the picture (#965) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1437
* macOS: Word for Mac's keys for Save As, Insert Endnote, New Comment, Replace and the ribbon (gap #24) by @spiritbearlabs in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1438
* Proofing: status bar flags a language whose dictionary isn't installed (#1167) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1441
* A file name that isn't valid Unicode no longer crashes wordcraft-cli or the app (#1440) by @Nael-Nathanael in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1444
* fix(engine): handle multi-byte UTF-8 characters before em-dash in dash_autoformat by @divyanshu2074 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1570
* fix(engine): trim arguments when parsing sample text formulas by @divyanshu2074 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1571
* .doc import: notes, headers and text boxes read their text once (#1319) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1572
* Layout: widow control moves a three-line paragraph whole by @przemek-arch in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1575
* Lists: Russian letter numbering draws а) б) в) instead of digits by @alik654zx in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1577
* Flat OPC: reading bounded everywhere in the file, CDATA base64 read (#1353) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1580
* Text boxes in tables nested deeper than 16 survive edits (#1339) by @rabis7575 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1591
* Layout: a table's percentage width past 100% is kept by @finwarman in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1598
* Layout: page numbers can restart at 0 by @finwarman in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1601
* Save Changes prompt takes the keyboard from the page (#1597) by @alik654zx in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1602
* Comments: deleting a comment leaves no dangling anchors or replies (#1345) by @squaredcow in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1565
* All Caps draws ß as SS, as Word does (#1581) by @dkhlapov in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1583
* Italian proofing: po', qual è, È and un/un' grammar rules; more elisions in spelling by @lupant in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1585
* Respect the image byte limit during DOC DIB conversion by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1590
* Shapes: a right triangle keeps its right angle by @finwarman in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1599
* Equations: a multi-letter subscript stays whole after build-up by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1623
* Tabs left of the margin stay on a default stop they already sit on (Word) by @Morzilla in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1631
* CI: VML shape type 6 is a right triangle in the preset-mapping test by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1900
